reason: I already pay for AngelSense every month and I'd be stacking a second monthly bill on top of it for something that does the same core job. I can't justify two trackers when the money's already tight with Mom's care costs.
objection: Why would I pay $249 plus $24.99 a month for a company I've never heard of, with a camera on my mom, when the tracker I trust already does the GPS and SOS part? The name even says TODO, so it feels unfinished.
would_change_my_mind: If it replaced my current tracker and cost less per month than what I pay now, with a proven record from families in my Facebook group.
